# [optional.ref.monadic] generated by specgen

The monadic operations of `optional<T&>` in `include/beman/optional/optional.hpp`
carry [specgen](https://github.com/steve-downey/specgen) markup (`//!` comments).
This directory holds the wording specgen generates from them, as an example for
review of the form of the wording.

| File | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `wording.tex` | the generated wording, draft LaTeX |
| `wording.md` | the same, mpark/wg21 markdown |
| `diff-vs-draft.tex`, `diff-vs-draft.md` | the generated wording marked against the working draft's [optional.ref.monadic] |
| `specgen-version.txt` | the specgen that wrote them |
| `generate.sh` | regenerates all of the above |

The diff was taken against cplusplus/draft at `604674fa` (2026-11-20).

```sh
SPECGEN=/path/to/specgen DRAFT_SOURCE=/path/to/draft/source ./generate.sh
```

Only this subclause is marked up, so `specgen generate --validate` still reports
the rest of the header as undescribed; it reports nothing for this subclause.
